findings.evidence: Only occurrence outside its own statement is line 115 `.ofCoeff (Finsupp.ofSupportFinite _ (finite_support_finrank_genWeightSpace K L M))`; grep for the name shows no other use in `code/TauCeti`.
findings.fix: Mark it `private`. The definition's body is not exposed (plain `public section`, no `@[expose]`), so a private helper is usable there, and `formalCharacter_coeff` remains the only public handle.
findings.issue: `finite_support_finrank_genWeightSpace` is public but serves only the `Finsupp.ofSupportFinite` argument in the definition on line 115; it is not in the module docstring's Main results and has no consumer (its statement, the support of the ℤ-cast finrank as a function on `Dual K L`, is the internal shape of the definition).

findings.evidence: `AddMonoidAlgebra.single` at mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/MonoidAlgebra/Defs.lean:222; `Weight.instFinite` at mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/Weights/Basic.lean:694 supplies the finite index; roadmap Suggested.lean:387-402 builds the Weyl numerator/denominator/formula out of the same group algebra.
findings.fix: Add `formalCharacter_eq_sum_single : formalCharacter K L M = ∑ w : Weight K L M, .single (w : Dual K L) (finrank K (genWeightSpace M w) : ℤ)` (provable in the `Defs` section, no `IsTriangularizable` needed, since the coefficient vanishes off the weights).
findings.issue: The API gives elimination (`formalCharacter_coeff`) but no introduction form: nothing relates `formalCharacter` to `AddMonoidAlgebra.single`, i.e. to `e^μ`, although the docstring justifies the group-algebra carrier by exactly that structure (`ch M = ∑_μ dim Mμ · e^μ`), and the downstream roadmap targets (`weylNumerator`, `weylDenominator`, `weyl_character_formula`) are built from `single`.

findings.evidence: Line 211 `@[simp] theorem mem_genWeightSpace_prod_iff`; precedent for the `= ⊥` iff form as simp: `@[simp] theorem weightSpace_weylGroup_smul_eq_bot_iff` at TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Weights/WeylInvariance.lean:352.
findings.fix: Tag both `@[simp]`. Neither loops: each rewrites a statement about `M × N` into statements about the factors, matching the sibling `mem_genWeightSpace_prod_iff` which is already `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: `genWeightSpace_prod_eq_bot_iff` (line 226) and `finrank_genWeightSpace_prod` (line 281) are normal-form decomposition lemmas for a product module but carry no `@[simp]`; the proof of `formalCharacter_prod` on line 291 has to pass `finrank_genWeightSpace_prod` to `simp` by hand.

summary: The character's elimination API (`formalCharacter_coeff`, the vanishing iff, congr, total dimension, additivity, Killing-section restatements) is in good shape and bodies are correctly unexposed, but an implementation-only finiteness helper is public, there is no introduction form relating the definition to the group-algebra basis it was given for, and two product lemmas that are normal forms lack `@[simp]`.
